name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
title: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd - 543253 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Biscuit and bakery demand soft but guided to low-to-mid-teens FY27 growth; ~3% input inflation covered by pricing and Project IMPACT, with EBITDA margin improvement targeted QoQ from Q4's 12.7% bakery margin. Capacity added, no capex discipline signal.

utilisation.quote: it will not be fair to tell you exactly percentage, this is the percentage

capex.quote: Our Mumbai plant commissioned in Q4 FY26. It is now in its ramp-up phase

triggers.label: Competitor sub-INR5 pricing reverting
triggers.quote: one of the large players is still into transition has not fully transitioned

triggers.label: Biscuits FY27 low-to-mid-teens growth
triggers.quote: We are very confident of touching on the biscuit segment somewhere between low to mid-teens kind of growth in this financial year.

triggers.label: Input inflation ~3% to be covered
triggers.quote: we look at around 3% impact, which comes in from all our areas

guidance.quote: somewhere between low to mid-teens kind of growth in this financial year
Bakery will be at a mid-teens kind of level on an overall basis.

guidance.value: improve QoQ in Q1 and Q2 FY27; objective as close as possible to 14%
guidance.quote: Objective is to get as close as possible to 14%
increase them by 40,000 outlets this financial year

prior_guidance_check.metric: EBITDA margin ~14% by H1 and above 14% for full year
prior_guidance_check.quote: Objective is to get as close as possible to 14%

red_flags.label: Export incentive (DFIA) on hold
red_flags.quote: on the export incentive, we are pursuing with the government. And on restart of the incentive, but still the file is in progress.

red_flags.label: Biscuit growth 'somber', sub-INR5 price war
red_flags.quote: I would say it was a somber kind of growth.

evasions.quote: it will not be fair to tell you exactly percentage, this is the percentage
how much are we hedging or what has been our hedge at a particular time when prices have gone up or gone down is actually -- it's not to be disclosed
